name: Hermanus
tagline: Whales from the cliffs and Cape Agulhas
summary: Hermanus is the world's best place to watch whales from land: southern right whales come into Walker Bay to calve from June to November. Walk the cliff path, take a boat trip, cage-dive with sharks at nearby Gansbaai, taste wine in the Hemel-en-Aarde valley and drive to Cape Agulhas, Africa's southernmost tip.
seasonNote: Whale season is June to November, peaking September and October.
arrival: About 1 hour 30 minutes by car from Cape Town along the coast.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere. Tip 10 to 15 percent in restaurants and a few rand to car guards.
foodTip: Seafood, Hemel-en-Aarde Pinot Noir and fish and chips.
baseArea: Village centre near the Old Harbour
